verdict.rationale: The evidence touches only the execution surface. Skills can bundle executable scripts (docs-52) and run in the API's code execution environment (docs-10). Frontmatter controls who can invoke a skill (docs-34), the Agent SDK can restrict which skills Claude can invoke (docs-63), and bundled skills can be disabled (docs-4). Nothing in the pack documents a trust model or vetting for third-party marketplace skills, or any telemetry or data-collection disclosure for skills. Missing for 10: a documented trust and vetting model for third-party or marketplace skills, an explicit description of execution permissions and sandbox boundaries, a telemetry and data-collection disclosure, and independent security review.
